args.command:
curl -s "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
models = data.get('data', [])

# Current configured models on openrouter
configured = set([
    'anthropic/claude-opus-4.5', 'x-ai/grok-4.1-fast', 'qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct',
    'minimax/minimax-m2.5', 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-001', 'openai/gpt-4o-mini',
    'google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview', 'openai/gpt-5.3-codex',
    'x-ai/grok-4.20-beta', 'x-ai/grok-4.20-multi-agent-beta',
    'openai/gpt-oss-120b', 'google/gemini-3-flash-preview', 'google/gemini-3-pro-preview',
    'google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview', 'google/gemini-2.5-flash',
    'z-ai/glm-4.5-air', 'z-ai/glm-4.7-flash', 'openai/gpt-5.4-nano',
    'minimax/minimax-m2.7', 'z-ai/glm-5-turbo', 'z-ai/glm-4.7',
    'z-ai/glm-4.5-air:free', 'z-ai/glm-5', 'deepseek/deepseek-v3.2',
    'openai/gpt-5.4-mini', 'google/gemini-2.5-pro', 'qwen/qwen3.5-flash-02-23',
    'openai/gpt-4.1-nano', 'openai/o3', 'openai/gpt-oss-20b',
    'qwen/qwen3-8b', 'qwen/qwen3.6-plus:free', 'anthropic/claude-opus-4.6',
    'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6', 'minimax/minimax-m2.5:free', 'z-ai/glm-5.1',
    'nvidia/nemotron-nano-9b-v2:free', 'nvidia/nemotron-nano-12b-v2-vl:free',
    'nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free', 'nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b:free',
    'anthropic/claude-opus-4.7', 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5',
    'anthropic/claude-opus-4.6-fast', 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash', 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro',
])

# Find new models (not in configured set, excluding :free duplicates and ~ aliases)
new_models = []
for m in models:
    mid = m['id']
    if mid in configured:
        continue
    if mid.startswith('~'):
        continue
    # Skip if the non-free version is already configured
    base = mid.replace(':free', '')
    if base in configured:
        continue
    created = m.get('created', 0)
    pricing = m.get('pricing', {})
    prompt_p = float(pricing.get('prompt', '1') or '1')
    ctx = m.get('context_length', 0)
    # Filter: reasonable context, not too expensive, not free-only OCR/specialty
    if ctx >= 100000 and prompt_p < 0.0001 and prompt_p >= 0:
        new_models.append((mid, created, ctx, prompt_p))

new_models.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
print('=== New models worth adding (ctx>=100K, prompt<\$0.0001) ===')
for mid, created, ctx, pp in new_models:
    from datetime import datetime
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(created).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if created else '?'
    print(f'{mid:50s} created={dt}  ctx={ctx:>10,}  prompt=\${pp}')
" 2>&1
